name: Gust Johs Huhtala — wife Lisa Jöransdotter and son Jöran (b. 1820, Kauhava)
researcher_question: Did Gust Johs Huhtala of Kauhava, Vaasa have a son Jöran, born 3 February 1820 to a wife named Lisa Jöransdotter — or does that baptism belong to a different Huhtala household?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 10, hint-samples.csv row 356, flag adds_spouse, confidence 3). Draft transcribed from an 1820 Finnish baptismal index entry; unverified. Two independent objections — an impossible birth interval and a different patronymic — point at a second Huhtala household.
